notes: K3 'Civic Forum': open forum court (≈620 m² + 120 m² arcade) crossed by two public axes (bridge → garden, Mazowiecka → Oława boulevard); separate Citizens' Entrance with 2 lifts straight to the public gallery; 'Sejmik Window' in a granite frame facing the forum; 13,683 m² GFA, 146.6 M PLN; 38 of 44 trees kept.

K5 'Bands & Lantern': one rounded corner (R 14 m, as on the 1934 plan) is both the arched entrance portico and, at the top, the Sejmik hall panorama over the Odra & Ostrów Tumski; horizontal bands on wings vs granite pilasters on the tower; 13,090 m² GFA, 146.5 M PLN; 40 of 46 trees kept (all garden trees).
All four comply on paper with MPZP height bands, §13 for Słowackiego 5 (tower 18–22 m away vs 16.7–17.5 m required) and the budget (146.5–148.6 M PLN) — the jury will test the numbers independently.
Common risk flagged by every author: the mezzanine on the Sejmik storey (must be argued as part of the same storey under WT §3); zone-A line digitised ±0.3 m.
Context scene (right): official survey DTM, bridge with restored pylon helmets, river, existing trees in autumn colour, neighbouring blocks — ready to receive the chosen design.
